title: Document the relation graph
description: Three places describe the roadmap and need the graph. README.md, section Roadmap: one paragraph and the command heist graph. docs/implementation-decisions.md: a new section at the end with today's date that records what was built and the decision HEIST-47 (layered columns, own SVG, no library, all relation types, tickets without relations counted but not drawn, Dependencies table kept). src/onboard.js, section Roadmap: one line for heist graph --format json and the URL mode graph. Write plain English, short sentences, no marketing words.
why: Agents learn commands from the briefing and people from the README; a view nobody knows of is not used.

acceptance.text: README names heist graph and the Graph tab
The decision is recorded in docs/implementation-decisions.md
heist agent onboard mentions heist graph

outcome.summary: README, docs/implementation-decisions.md and src/onboard.js describe the Graph tab, heist graph, the URL mode graph and decision HEIST-47.
outcome.verifiedBy: node --test passes; heist agent onboard prints the heist graph lines
